description: This is a test source file containing integration tests for board-related functionalities in the focalboard server, including creation, retrieval, updating, deletion, duplication, and membership management of boards.

methods.name: TestGetBoards
methods.description: Tests retrieval of boards for a team, including filtering by user membership and team ID.

methods.name: TestCreateBoard
methods.description: Tests creation of public and private boards, including validation and permission checks.

methods.name: TestCreateBoardTemplate
methods.description: Tests creation of board templates (public and private) and access permissions.

methods.name: TestGetAllBlocksForBoard
methods.description: Tests retrieval of all blocks within a board, including nested block structures.

methods.name: TestSearchBoards
methods.description: Tests searching for boards with various search terms, including permissions filtering.

methods.name: TestGetBoard
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a specific board with different permission scenarios and read tokens.

methods.name: TestGetBoardMetadata
methods.description: Tests retrieval of board metadata, including descendant block updates and permissions.

methods.name: TestPatchBoard
methods.description: Tests updating board properties with permission validation.

methods.name: TestDeleteBoard
methods.description: Tests deletion of boards with permission checks.

methods.name: TestUndeleteBoard
methods.description: Tests restoring deleted boards with permission validation.

methods.name: TestGetMembersForBoard
methods.description: Tests retrieval of board members, including permission restrictions.

methods.name: TestAddMember
methods.description: Tests adding members to a board, role assignment, and permission validation.

methods.name: TestUpdateMember
methods.description: Tests updating board member roles, including validation against admin and guest constraints.

methods.name: TestDeleteMember
methods.description: Tests removing members from a board with permission validation.

methods.name: TestGetTemplates
methods.description: Tests retrieval of built-in templates and their duplication.

methods.name: TestDuplicateBoard
methods.description: Tests duplicating boards, including from categories, and verifying member roles and categories.

methods.name: TestJoinBoard
methods.description: Tests joining public boards with different minimum roles and permission scenarios.
